snapshot.text: A health system split by war between the government and Houthi-held areas, largely kept running by humanitarian aid. WHO says it is at breaking point, with cholera rising and about 20 million people needing health aid.

priorities.title: Avoiding collapse
priorities.text: The health minister warned in September 2026 that the system could collapse in some areas.

priorities.title: Cholera response
priorities.text: Cholera cases are rising as the fragile system comes under more pressure.
